about.title: Decor made by hand
about.subtitle: Crafty Corner makes plaster and ceramic decor by hand and delivers it to your door in Cairo, Giza and Qalyubia.
about.story1: Crafty Corner started from a love of handmade things. Every piece, from lanterns to incense burners to figurines, is shaped, painted and prepared by hand.
about.story2: That is why every piece is a little different. We wrap every order with care so it reaches you just as it left our hands.

genuine.title: Handmade
genuine.text: Every piece is made by hand, so small differences from the photo are normal.

prices.title: Clear prices
prices.text: The delivery fee is shown in your cart before you order, and you pay in cash on delivery. No hidden fees.

delivery.title: Delivery to your door
delivery.text: We deliver in Cairo, Giza and Qalyubia for now, and we call you to arrange the time.
